name: relai-progress
description: Early access — needs Claude Code with mods (measured on 2.1.293). RelAI progress above the prompt: segments of the stage in progress or a /relai-crew run with the next item under them, a chip with the session's agents and their cost, and /relai-agents with the session's subagents priced from the project's price list. Reads files only: no model call, no network. Based on savvy-progress by johnnyvizz (MIT).
